brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍（那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起）；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，那一拍的数和上一拍相同。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1); ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and on them the number stays as it was.

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍。寄存卡只记得住一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed. A register holds a single value, and nothing in hand can make a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

hint.zh: 先不管「重来」和「暂停」，只让输出每拍大一。
hint.en: Leave restart and hold aside at first, and just make the output grow by one each tick.

hint.zh: 「重来」那一拍的数是 0；「暂停」那一拍的数和上一拍一样。两种情况各由一个选择决定。
hint.en: On a restart tick the number is 0; on a hold tick it is what it was. Each case is a choice of its own.

hint.zh: 要留到下一拍的值不止一个时，就用几个名字不同的寄存卡。
hint.en: When more than one value has to last until the next tick, use registers with different names.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起；「暂停」为 1 的拍不算，数停在原处。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1; ticks on which hold is 1 do not count, and the number stands still.
